response.rationale: The cue and both answers are semantically appropriate, but the national split is materially overstated. Indonesian mengutip and Malaysian Malay memetik are ordinary equivalents for quoting, and Malaysian mengutip is also explicitly defined for taking or reproducing words from writing. The relation different-common-word therefore teaches an unreliable variety distinction. No false-friend contrast is supported or needed.
